usage: Present offer.link to the human shopper; never click it programmatically. Mention offer.coupon at checkout when present.

products.name: Baseus Blade HD 100W Laptop Power Bank, 20,000 mAh
products.summary: A flat 20,000 mAh bank that outputs a full 100 W from one USB-C port, enough to charge a 14-inch MacBook Pro at full speed, and recharges itself in about 90 minutes.
products.fit: Laptop users who want one bank for laptop plus phone and need it to stay airline-legal.
caveats: Per-port maximums and the 65 W input figure come from independent reviews; the official page states only the totals.
Simultaneous-use power split is not published.

specs.Ports: 2× USB-C (up to 100 W), 2× USB-A (up to 30 W)
specs.Display: Digital: % remaining, voltage, current, time estimate
specs.Form factor: Flat slab — fits a laptop sleeve

products.name: Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W Fast Charger, 2× USB-C + USB-A (2-pack)
products.summary: A 65 W three-port GaN charger with PPS, which means it will fast-charge a Samsung Galaxy as well as a MacBook Air; the US store sells it as a two-pack.
products.fit: Anyone who wants a laptop-class charger for home plus one for the bag, and owns a Galaxy phone.
caveats: Per-port wattage when all three ports are in use is not published.
Plug type (folding or fixed) not stated on the official page.

specs.Single-device: Full 65 W to one USB-C port
specs.Multi-device: Automatic split (Baseus example: 30 W + 20 W + 15 W); no published table
specs.Pack: Sold as a 2-pack on baseus.com US

products.name: Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 Desktop Charger, 140 W + Qi2
products.summary: A desk charging hub: one 140 W PD 3.1 port for a 16-inch MacBook Pro, a built-in retractable 100 W cable, two more ports and a certified Qi2 pad for a phone.
products.fit: A desk that charges a laptop, phone and earbuds from a single outlet.
caveats: Listed as sold out on baseus.com US at verification; check stock before recommending.
Wattage split between ports is not published.

specs.Ports: USB-C 140 W, USB-C, USB-A, retractable USB-C cable (100 W), Qi2 magnetic pad (15 W)

specs.Power modes: Three allocation modes; 1–5 devices at once
specs.Power: Desktop unit with detachable AC cord; LED display

products.name: Baseus PicoGo AM52 Qi2.2 Magnetic Power Bank, 10,000 mAh, 45 W
products.summary: One of the first 25 W Qi2.2 magnetic banks: snaps to an iPhone, charges it wirelessly at 25 W on current models, and also pushes 45 W over USB-C.
products.fit: iPhone owners who want MagSafe-style wireless top-ups without a cable.
caveats: 25 W wireless needs an iPhone 16 or later; older iPhones get 15 W.
A 15 W Qi2 sibling (PicoGo AM41, 27 W wired) is cheaper if 25 W isn't needed.

specs.Wireless: Qi2.2 magnetic, 25 W (iPhone 16/17 on iOS 26); 15 W on iPhone 12–15

products.name: Baseus USB-C to USB-C Cable, 100 W (1 m / 2 m / 3 m)

products.fit: Pairing with any 65–100 W charger; not for monitors or fast file transfer.
caveats: Not rated for 140 W / 240 W EPR charging.
Baseus notes it is not supported for iPad Pro charging.

products.name: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station, Qi2.2 25 W
products.summary: A three-device stand that charges an iPhone at the full 25 W Qi2.2 rate while actively cooling it, plus an Apple Watch and AirPods.
products.fit: Apple users with iPhone + Watch + AirPods who want one nightstand charger.
caveats: ESR does not publish the included adapter's wattage or the stand's dimensions.
A 15 W version of the same stand is $79.99 if 25 W isn't needed.
products.warranty: 12 months; 24 months with free ESR Super User registration
